CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activate_student(p_admission_no text, p_dob date, p_mobile text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_student public.students%rowtype;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;

  select s.* into v_student
  from public.students s
  where lower(trim(s.admission_no)) = lower(trim(p_admission_no))
    and s.dob = p_dob
    and regexp_replace(coalesce(s.registered_mobile,''),'[^0-9]','','g') = regexp_replace(coalesce(p_mobile,''),'[^0-9]','','g')
  limit 1;

  if v_student.id is null then raise exception 'Student verification failed'; end if;

  update public.profiles
    set school_id = v_student.school_id,
        updated_at = now()
  where id = auth.uid();

  insert into public.user_roles(user_id, school_id, role)
  values (auth.uid(), v_student.school_id, 'student'::public.app_role)
  on conflict do nothing;

  return v_student.id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.teacher_assessment_is_assigned(p_teacher_id uuid, p_school_id uuid, p_academic_year_id uuid, p_class_id uuid, p_section_id uuid, p_subject_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.teachers t
    join public.teacher_subject_assignments tsa on tsa.teacher_id = t.id
    join public.classes c on c.id = p_class_id and c.school_id = p_school_id
    join public.academic_years ay on ay.id = p_academic_year_id and ay.school_id = p_school_id
    where t.id = p_teacher_id
      and t.profile_id = (select auth.uid())
      and t.school_id = p_school_id
      and tsa.academic_year_id = p_academic_year_id
      and tsa.class_id = p_class_id
      and tsa.subject_id = p_subject_id
      and (tsa.section_id is null or tsa.section_id = p_section_id)
      and (
        p_section_id is null
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.sections s
          where s.id = p_section_id and s.class_id = p_class_id
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.write_audit_log(p_school_id uuid, p_action text, p_module text, p_entity_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_entity_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_description text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
  v_role text;
begin

  if not public.is_school_admin_for_school(p_school_id) then
    raise exception 'Not authorized for this school';
  end if;

  select ur.role::text
  into v_role
  from public.user_roles as ur
  where ur.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and ur.school_id = p_school_id
  limit 1;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    school_id,
    user_id,
    role,
    action,
    module,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    description,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    p_school_id,
    (select auth.uid()),
    v_role,
    p_action,
    p_module,
    p_entity_type,
    p_entity_id,
    p_description,
    coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
  )
  returning id into v_id;

  return v_id;

end;
$function$

relations.name: student_fee_summary
relations.view_definition:
SELECT student_id,
    school_id,
    COALESCE(sum(amount), (0)::numeric) AS billed_amount,
    COALESCE(sum(discount), (0)::numeric) AS discount_amount,
    COALESCE(sum(late_fee), (0)::numeric) AS late_fee_amount,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (status = 'paid'::payment_status) THEN amount
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric) AS paid_assessed_amount,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::payment_status, 'partial'::payment_status]))) AS outstanding_items
   FROM student_fees sf
  GROUP BY student_id, school_id;
